content.title: Open a savings account online
content.description: A prospective customer opens a savings account on the web through a four-step wizard that starts on Account type, moves through About you, Fund it, and Review, keeps the current step visible and completed steps checked, allows back-navigation from step two onward, and only lets the applicant leave the identity step when required personal and contact details are present and correctly formed; in this demo scope the flow ends at “Open account” without real KYC, credit checks, money movement, or session persistence between visits.
content.summary: Open a savings account through the web wizard.
content.value: Acquires savings-account applications without a branch visit while screening out obviously invalid applicant data before downstream verification.
criteria: the onboarding wizard shows four steps in this order: Account type, About you, Fund it, and Review
the primary action reads "Continue →" on the first three steps and "Open account" on the final step, and a "← Back" control is available from step two onward
the stepper marks the current step and shows completed steps with a check
the Account type step is active on first load and advances to About you when the user continues with a selected product
attempting to continue from About you with empty fields keeps the user on About you and shows inline validation errors
required identity fields are first name, last name, street address, city, and state
email must be well-formed, and malformed email such as `notanemail` shows the message "Enter a valid email"
phone must contain at least 10 digits, SSN accepts exactly the last 4 digits, and ZIP must be exactly 5 digits

content.title: Calculate a federal income tax estimate
content.description: A prospective customer uses the Federal Income Tax Calculator to estimate either a federal refund or an amount owed, with results recalculated live as inputs change, no submit action, and no page reload; the calculator presents an ordered estimate breakdown, applies filing-status-based standard deductions or reveals an itemized-deductions input when Itemized is chosen, floors taxable income at zero, and displays values as whole-dollar US currency.
content.summary: Estimate a federal refund or amount owed live.
content.value: Helps visitors estimate tax outcome and decide how much they may want to deposit.
criteria: the calculator updates as the user types, with no submit button and no page reload
the estimate panel shows, in order, Gross income, Deductions, Taxable income, Tax liability, and Taxes withheld, then a total labelled either "Estimated refund" or "Estimated amount you owe"
standard deductions are Single $14,600, Married filing jointly $29,200, and Head of household $21,900
taxable income equals gross income minus the deduction, floored at zero
choosing "Itemized" reveals an itemized deductions input
displayed amounts use whole-dollar US currency

content.title: Compare savings account products
content.description: A prospective customer reviews the savings products offered on the Open Account page before entering personal data, sees each product’s APY and minimum opening deposit up front, and can rely on High-Yield Savings being preselected while still changing the choice to another highlighted product.
content.summary: Review and compare available savings products.
content.value: Lets visitors make an informed product choice before beginning the application.
criteria: the Open Account page offers exactly three products: High-Yield Savings, Everyday Savings, and Money Market

product terms shown up front are High-Yield Savings 4.34% APY with $0 minimum opening deposit, Everyday Savings 3.10% APY with $0 minimum opening deposit, and Money Market 4.00% APY with $100 minimum opening deposit
all three savings products are fee-free and their APY and minimum opening deposit are shown before personal data is requested
High-Yield Savings is selected by default on page load, and changing the product highlights the chosen option

content.title: Move between the Open Account and Calculators pages
content.description: A visitor uses the persistent bank header to move between the site’s main account-opening and calculator areas without relying on the browser’s back button, including navigating from the Calculators page to the Open Account page.
content.summary: Navigate between the site’s two main banking areas.
content.value: Supports exploration across related banking tools without forcing browser-back navigation.
criteria: the bank header is present on both the Open Account page and the Calculators page
from the Calculators page, the header link to Open Account navigates to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`

props.quote: - A first-time visitor can open a savings account in under 5 minutes.

The application is a four-step wizard with a visible stepper:
**Account type → About you → Fund it → Review**. The primary button reads
"Continue →" on the first three steps and "Open account" on the final step.
A "← Back" control returns to the previous step from step two onward.

Step two collects identity and contact details. We must not let an
applicant advance with incomplete or malformed data, because downstream
verification would reject it.

Validation runs when the user attempts to continue. Invalid fields show an
inline error message beneath the field, and the user stays on the step.

- Real KYC, credit checks, or money movement. This is a demo surface.
- Mobile-specific layouts, native apps, and localization.
- Saving or persisting applicant data between sessions.
